General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)

What is this Part?

These are the Bolts, Washers & Lock Washers that Attach the Hood to the Body.
Includes All Hardware for Both Hinges!
Direct Replacement

Qty 4 – Bolts
Qty 4 – Washers

Suzuki SJ410 1982 – 1984 All Models

Suzuki Jimny
Holden Drover
